answer: My answer to sybils is Proof of unique land title history with land registry attestation — titles the registry recorded across transfers over years — which makes the walnut of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: titles the registry recorded across transfers over years is fresh per account, and the jetty is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the reef of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
